title: ASIC Test Engineer
jd:
We are looking for an experienced Test Engineer to join our team on a temporary assignment. The successful candidate will be responsible for setting up and debugging chip test benches, executing validation tests, analyzing measurement data, and coordinating test activities with both internal technical teams and external test-service providers.

This is a hands-on role, with most of the time spent in the laboratory.




Key Responsibilities

Set up, configure, and debug IC/chip test benches, including laboratory instruments, power supplies, evaluation boards, fixtures, cabling, automation scripts, and data-acquisition systems.
Execute functional and parametric tests according to defined validation plans and test specifications.
Collect, process, and analyze measurement data to identify anomalies, trends, and potential issues.
Correlate test results with design expectations and specifications, and work closely with design and validation teams to investigate discrepancies.
Troubleshoot test setups, measurement issues, and device-related problems.
Develop and maintain test automation scripts and data-analysis tools using Python, MATLAB, or similar environments.
Prepare clear and concise test reports, including plots, measurements, observations, pass/fail criteria, conclusions, and recommended next steps.
Document test setups, procedures, results, and identified issues in a structured and traceable manner.
Coordinate with external test houses / test-service providers on test setup requirements, test implementation, logistics, data exchange, issue tracking, and schedule follow-up.
Participate in technical reviews and communicate test results and issues effectively to international teams.
Contribute to continuous improvement of test methodologies, automation, and laboratory setups.




Required Profile

Minimum 5 years of professional experience in IC testing, electronic system testing, validation, or a similar engineering environment.
Solid hands-on experience with laboratory measurement equipment, such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, electronic loads, source-measure units, and signal generators.
Experience with PCB-based test setups, evaluation boards, fixtures, cabling, and laboratory instrumentation.
Strong knowledge of structured data analysis and measurement interpretation.
Mandatory experience with Python, MATLAB, or a similar programming/automation environment.
Experience developing or maintaining test automation scripts is highly desirable.
Ability to troubleshoot complex test setups and distinguish between test equipment, setup, and device-related issues.
Experience with PMICs, voltage regulators, power management ICs, or mixed-signal devices is a strong plus.
Comfortable working predominantly in a laboratory environment and performing hands-on testing.
Strong attention to detail and a rigorous approach to measurement and reporting.
Pragmatic, autonomous, and solution-oriented mindset.
Good communication skills and ability to work effectively with international multidisciplinary teams.
Comfortable interacting with external test houses and test-service providers.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

title: Electronic Engineer (Remote | $50–$90/hr)
jd:
Electronic Design Engineer 




Position: Electronic Design Engineer




Type: Contractor




Compensation: $50–$90/hour




Location: Remote




About the Opportunity

We are seeking experienced Altium Designer Specialists to contribute to a project focused on real-world PCB design workflows and engineering documentation. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in Altium Designer to complete practical design tasks, document workflows, and support the development of next-generation AI systems through high-quality technical contributions.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in schematic design, PCB layout, routing, component placement, and design validation. You will work on realistic engineering scenarios, create detailed documentation, and help evaluate technical outputs using industry best practices.

The work is fully remote, flexible, and centered on authentic PCB design and electronics engineering workflows. No prior AI experience is required.

Key Responsibilities

Complete assigned workflows and engineering tasks within Altium Designer.
Create, modify, review, and validate PCB layouts and schematic designs.
Utilize Altium Designer tools for component placement, routing, design rule checks, and design validation.
Record your screen while completing assigned workflows and clearly demonstrate your process.
Document workflow steps, design decisions, and tool usage throughout each task.
Create realistic prompts, evaluation tasks, and detailed scoring rubrics based on completed workflows.
Review outputs for technical accuracy, completeness, and adherence to project requirements.
Provide structured feedback to improve AI-generated engineering workflows.
Follow project guidelines and quality standards while working independently in a remote environment.

Required Qualifications

Strong hands-on experience using Altium Designer.
Experience with schematic capture, PCB layout, routing, and design verification workflows.
Ability to independently complete professional PCB design tasks.
Excellent written communication and technical documentation skills.
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to explain engineering workflows and design decisions clearly.
Comfortable working remotely and independently.

Preferred Qualifications

Professional experience in PCB design, electronics engineering, hardware development, or related fields.
Current access to Altium Designer and ability to use the software independently.
Experience creating design documentation, manufacturing files, and engineering deliverables.
Familiarity with design rule checks (DRC), signal integrity considerations, and PCB validation processes.
Prior experience with AI evaluation, model assessment, technical annotation, or related projects.
Experience recording and presenting technical workflows.
Background in electrical engineering, electronics design, embedded systems, or hardware product development.

Compensation

$50–$90/hour
Remote contract engagement
Flexible schedule
Project-based work

Additional Details

Fully remote opportunity.
Flexible workload with no fixed schedule.
Applications reviewed on a rolling basis.
No prior AI experience required.
Work involves completing real-world Altium Designer workflows and documenting professional engineering processes.

reelance HV Engineer – Data Centre Projects | Europe

Location: Various locations across Europe

Contract: Freelance / Contract

Duration: 6–12+ months

Start: Immediate / Flexible

Sector: Data Centres / Mission Critical

We are currently supporting multiple data centre construction and commissioning projects across Europe and are looking for experienced HV Engineers to join project teams on a freelance basis.

These opportunities are suited to HV professionals with experience working on large-scale, complex electrical projects, ideally within data centres, mission-critical environments, industrial facilities, or major infrastructure projects.

Key Responsibilities

Support the delivery of HV electrical systems throughout construction, installation and commissioning.
Coordinate HV installation activities with contractors, subcontractors and other project disciplines.
Review electrical drawings, specifications, method statements and inspection documentation.
Ensure HV works are delivered safely, on programme and to required quality standards.
Support testing, commissioning and energisation activities.
Coordinate with project management, electrical teams and commissioning teams.
Monitor progress and identify technical issues or potential project risks.
Ensure works comply with relevant European standards, project specifications and HSE requirements.
Participate in inspections, testing and handover activities.
Provide technical support throughout the project lifecycle.

Requirements

Proven experience working as an HV Engineer / HV Electrical Engineer.
Strong knowledge of HV electrical systems, installation and testing.
Experience within data centres, mission-critical, industrial, energy or major infrastructure projects.
Ability to interpret electrical drawings and technical documentation.
Strong understanding of HV safety procedures, permits and isolation processes.
Experience working with contractors and multidisciplinary project teams.
Relevant electrical/HV qualifications and certifications.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Willingness to work on projects across Europe.
